build_BaseDetector_subclass: build a python module that subclasses BaseDetector to implement a custom object detector with loss and predict methods
run_BaseDetector_forward: run the BaseDetector forward method in tensor mode to get raw network outputs without post-processing
test_BaseDetector_loss: test the BaseDetector loss method by passing batch inputs and data samples to calculate detection losses
review_BaseDetector_properties: review the BaseDetector with_bbox and with_mask properties to check if the detector has bounding box or mask heads
create_BaseDetector_extract_feat: create a python module that uses BaseDetector extract_feat to extract features from input image tensors
